label: Esse = essence puts existence in the nature, from exercise in it and the act-fact link
meaning: For a being x with represented esse equal to its essence, exercise in the nature puts into x's nature the proposition that x's act of being is exercised; the act-fact link makes that proposition true at exactly the points where x exists, so (by extensionality of world-propositions) it is the proposition that x exists. So x's existence lies in its nature: the unconditional bridge. The passage from esse as act (_6) to existence as fact (_1) is the explicit act-fact premise; the passage from the q.3 a.4 essence (ESSENCE_3) to the Finean essential truth (ESSENCE_5) is the explicit exercise-in-the-nature premise.
